prediction_text: (1) Irish forces: The King will not procure effective forces out of Ireland that harm the Parliament. Aid is signified but imperfect: the Sun, lord of the 11th (assistance), is exalted yet in the 7th in direct opposition to the Ascendant and still wanting six degrees of partile application to the 11th cusp — assistance is opposed, incomplete and delayed, not joined in force against Parliament. (2) The Queen: she will advance/move from the North, but she will not prosper. Her significatrix Saturn, lord of the 4th (7th from the 10th), is removing out of one sign into another and going into Aries, his fall — a change of condition for the worse, loss of dignity and strength on the advance. (3) Meeting: His Majesty will meet her. The Moon (the King's significator, in Cancer in the 10th in her own house, increasing in light, strong but slow) wants only three or four degrees of the trine of Saturn — a perfecting friendly aspect between King and Queen. Timing (month/week scale for a campaign movement): window of three to four weeks from the figure, main coordinate the fourth week, when the Moon-Saturn trine is perfected in degree-count. Overall direction negative for the royal war aims as asked (no harmful Irish aid, Queen advances without prospering), positive only on the meeting itself.
basis: Horary, Lilly Christian Astrology Book II, whole-sign/classical horary defaults per method. King=Moon in Cancer 10th, domicile, increasing, slow: dignity strong, speed slow. Aid=Sun lord 11th exalted in 7th, opp. Asc, 6 degrees short of partile to 11th cusp: aid exalted in show but opposed and unperfected. Queen=Saturn lord 4th changing sign into Aries fall: deterioration. Meeting=Moon applying trine Saturn wanting 3-4 degrees: perfecting trine, degrees read as weeks at campaign scale.
